name: WORLD_CORE_V08_PACKAGE_CONTINUATION

continuation_rule.condition: The immediately preceding V08 step has an immutable candidate and complete normal-engineering evidence with applicable automated checks passing and no recorded open P0 or MAJOR blocker, and every ADR required at the next step boundary is APPROVED or authoritatively not current for the exact implemented scope.
continuation_rule.effect: The immediately following dependency-ready V08 step may start on codex/world-core-v08 without claiming verification.
continuation_rule.dependency_exception: An IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED dependency is accepted only between adjacent members of the exact allowed_steps sequence.

preserved_controls: V08 steps remain IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED unless independently promoted
normal engineering acceptance, exact conservation, deterministic rejection, architecture, environment, security and governance checks remain mandatory
ADR-02, ADR-05 and ADR-17 are approved architecture
ADR-07 remains deferred outside V08.1 inventory mechanics
ADR-08 remains a hard stop if rounding, FX, minor units or formula arithmetic requiring rounding enters scope
V07 Command, Event, Receipt, replay lineage and one-WorldVersion transition contract remain controlling
V09 retains lease, fencing, single-writer runtime, atomic commit coordination and recovery
candidate DDL remains branch-local and production-unpublished
V08 package Review B and owner-controlled promotion remain mandatory before main merge or V09
prohibitions: continue across an unresolved applicable ADR, recorded P0 or MAJOR blocker
merge candidate DDL before V08 package review and owner promotion authority
merge V08 to main before package Review B and merge authority
